courseTitle: 100 Days of Code: JavaScript Data Structures and Algorithms

lectures.title: Big O Notations - Theta , Omega and Big O

cues.en: All right.
In the last lecture we have learned what is the analogy behind the Big-O notation?
Now here we will look at different notations that are used in academics to describe runtimes.
But in the industry, people tend to use Big-O to understand different notations that are used to measure
the performance of algorithms.
Let's look at the real life example.
So let's say we want to buy a brand new car.
Obviously we want to know more about the performance of the car, which means that we are interested
in how many liters of petrol it takes to drive 100 miles.
Now, in case of car, there is not a standard answer for this question, even though in any car's manual
it might mention that it takes 70l of petrol for 100 mile.
This information is not direct because a car can perform differently based on the condition.
This number can be different based on which condition you are driving the car.
So if we drive the car in the city traffic, it's obvious that it takes more petrol to reach the 100
mile than when we drive it in the highway.
And there might be situations in which we drive a car in mixed condition, both traffic and highway.
Let's say it takes 20l to drive 100 miles in city traffic and ten litres on the highway, and 15l in
mixed condition.
So here we see that the same car can perform differently based on the condition that we drive it.
Similarly, algorithms can perform differently based on the condition that is given.
We might have three scenarios.
In case of measuring of the any given algorithm, these are the best, the worst, and average case.
So let's say an algorithm takes one minute to execute in worst case scenario.
But in the best case scenario, it takes five seconds to execute.
And finally, in the average case, it takes 30 and 50s to execute.
So with the help of the notation, we can define the best, worst and average case of the algorithm.
So when you are dealing with this kind of notations, there are three Greek letters that you will consistently
see.
They are omega, eta and Omicron.
So Omicron is better known as big O, and big O is the one that we are going to see most times.
So to explain this, I'm just going to bring up an array.
So let's say we are going to build a for loop to iterate through this array until we find the particular
number.
So for example, if you are looking for number one, we are just going to straight away find it because
it is located in the beginning of the array.
Now if you are looking for example, for number eight, all we have to do is we have to loop through
all these numbers and find out the A, because we have said that in this case, when we are looking
for numbers, we need a loop.
So first we are going to check first number, then second number, then third number.
If this is the eight or not until we find eight.
Now if you are looking for example for four, we are going to find it in the middle.
So it will take three numbers to find out the four.
So if we represent these cases with the Greek letters in this case, the first case in which we are
looking for number one is going to be the best case because it will take so less time to find the number
one.
So in this case we are going to represent this one with the Greek letter omega.
Now the average case in this case is going to be the number four, because it will take only three numbers
to find the number four.
And in terms of Greek letter, we are going to represent it with the big header.
And our worst case in this case is going to be the number eight.
Because to find eight, we have to loop through the all numbers in the array and find out the eight.
So this means that it's going to be represented with big O.
So in this case we learned that when we are representing it with the Omega it's going to be the best
case with the heater.
It's going to be average case.
And with big O it's going to be the worst case.
So we are always going to look at the worst case.
And it's very common for people saying that okay, this is your worst case.
Big O what is your best and average case.
Big O.
So technically there is no best and average case big O.
That would be Omega and ETA.
So when we are measuring the big O, we are always measuring worst case.
So this means that if we look at these notations separately, big O is going to be the complexity that's
going to be the less or equal to the worst case.
Big omega is going to be the complexity, which is going to be the least more than the best case.
And big ETA is going to be the complexity within the bounds of worst and best case.
So big O and big hitter is used mostly in the academics.
But when it comes to the industrial people, we always use the big O.
